user.title: Vacuum MapGuard
user.description: Pick the vacuum to protect. It gets hidden and renamed (for example vacuum.robot becomes vacuum.robot_roborock), and Vacuum MapGuard takes over its entity ID. Dashboards, automations and voice assistants keep working. Removing the entry undoes this.

data_description.entity_id: Only vacuums that support cleaning by area are listed.

error.no_unique_id: This vacuum has no unique ID, so Home Assistant can't rename it.
error.already_wrapped: This is already a Vacuum MapGuard vacuum.
error.no_clean_area: This vacuum doesn't support cleaning by area.

source_missing.message: The protected vacuum was removed from the entity registry. Delete this entry and add it again.

original_id_busy.message: {entity_id} is still in use, trying again shortly.

source_unavailable.message: The protected vacuum {entity_id} is not available.

init.title: Start order
init.description: Optional. Choose the areas that Start cleans and drag them into the order you want. Leave it empty to clean all rooms in the order the vacuum reports them. Only areas that have rooms assigned in the vacuum's Clean areas dialog count.
